summary: Frontend-only verification of printPdf() refactor in Assistente.jsx (Blob URL + window.open replacing document.write). Logged in as admin, loaded /app/assistente, tested chat (AI reply received, 3 message bubbles), generated Estruturado PDF (preview rendered, printPdf opened blob: URL via window.open with target=_blank, no errors), generated Personalizado PDF (iframe rendered, printPdf opened blob: URL, no errors). Zero page errors; no console errors referencing document/printPdf/blob. Download PDF button regression unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: printPdf() correctly revokes the Blob URL after 2s and handles blocked popups (returns early + revokes). Good XSS-safe pattern.
Minor: if window.open is blocked, user gets no feedback. Consider showing a toast when w is null (e.g., 'Permita janelas pop-up para imprimir').
File /app/frontend/src/pages/Assistente.jsx is 470 lines — still within guideline (<700) but approaching; consider splitting PDF/Chat panels in future.

Chat endpoint /api/ai/chat and PDF endpoints /api/ai/pdf-content and /api/ai/pdf-html responded successfully. No regressions detected.
